limitations: ArkTS/JS frontend: 44 file(s) parsed; 41 complete, 3 partial, 0 unsupported; 237 call site(s) recovered.

Public analysis coverage follows both frontends: complete requires a complete shared SourceUnit parse AND a complete private parse. Shared not_run/failed/partial stays partial inspection even when the private grammar recovers a complete tree; the preceding frontend counts describe the private parse only.

ArkTS `struct` and ArkTS decorators are outside the TypeScript grammar; a partial parse is reported for every such file and no component/decorator semantics are claimed from it. Only recovered call/class/property structure is read.

No CFG; taint crosses one same-file function hop at most (function declarations only, not methods or arrow functions). No manifest (module.json5) parsing, installed-package or page-origin facts. Guard detection is a bounded AST branch containment or direct preceding early rejection on the same argument. Reassignment invalidates the structural guard; this is not CFG/alias proof or validation of the predicate policy.
Ability surface: 1 exported Ability/Extension class(es) seen; export/permission state is an obligation, never inferred from the class.
WebView bridge coverage: 0 registration(s), 0 with an origin predicate in the same function.
Taint coverage: 2 path sink(s), 0 behind a same-function path predicate; 0 eval site(s).

N-API binding map: 0 .so module(s) and 0 function signature(s) declared in the scan's .d.ts files; 0 call site(s) into lib*.so imports, 0 unmapped (module or export not declared in this scan), 0 behind a same-function numeric predicate. A declaration is a type statement, not a runtime check.
All output is candidate/unassessed; no candidate is a vulnerability finding and no reachability is established by this frontend.
